blocks.html: Worry no more as Robinsons Malls is now a one-stop shop to install and reload your RFID safely and conveniently!

In partnership with Easytrip, Robinsons Malls is offering free RFID sticker installation at various Robinsons malls across Luzon in support of the contactless and cashless payment transactions in tollways as a precautionary measure against COVID-19.
The Easytrip RFID is for vehicles traversing the North Luzon Expressway (NLEX), Subic Clark Tarlac Expressway (SCTEX), Cavite Expressway (CAVITEX), Cavite-Laguna Expressway (CALAX), and C-5 Link
So, head over to the participating Robinsons Malls to get your free RFID sticker:
October 2 to 3 – Robinsons Galleria, Lower Ground Floor
October 9 to 10 – Robinsons Sta. Rosa and Robinsons Place Malolos, Ground Floor
October 16 to 17 – Robinsons Place Dasmariñas, Lower Ground Floor
October 23 to 24 – Robinsons Tagaytay, Level 2 Hallway and Robinsons Starmills, Parking Area
November 6 to 7 – Robinsons Angeles, Ground Floor Parking
November 13 to 14 – Robinsons Novaliches, Ground Floor
Robinsons Malls’ Easytrip booths and kiosks are open from 10:00 AM to 6:00 PM to cater your needs.

For more information, visit www.robinsonsmalls.com or like RobinsonsMalls on Facebook; follow @RobinsonsMallsOfficial on Instagram and @RobinsonsMalls on Twitter; and join their Viber Communities – Robinsons Malls Luzon for Luzon malls and Robinsons Malls VisMin for Visayas and Mindanao malls.
